Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID assigned daily, valid for trading day.

Field.Name: Current Trading State

Message.Name: Option Open Message
Message.Description: BX plans to disseminate the Option Open Message for each option as soon as the opening is completed. Upon receipt of the open state message, firms should be advised that the option denoted in the message is now available for auto execution within the BX Options Market System. Upon receipt of the closed state message, firms should be advised that the option is no longer eligible for auto-execution within the BX Options Market System.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID assigned daily, valid for trading day.

Field.Name: Open State
Field.Description: The allowable values are Yes and No

Message.Name: Add Order Message Short Form
Message.Description: An Add Order Message indicates that a new order has been accepted by the BX Option system and was added to the displayable book. The message includes a day-unique Order Reference Number used by BX to track the order.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Order Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The unique reference number delta assigned to the new order. The order reference number is Increasing, but not necessarily sequential.

Field.Name: Market Side
Field.Description: The type of order being added.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID assigned daily, valid for trading day.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the new order being added to the book. NOTE: When converted to a decimal format, this price is in fixed point format with 3 whole number places followed by 2 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The total number of contracts of the new order being added to the book.

Message.Name: Single Side Executed Message
Message.Description: A “Side order” represents an order or one side of a quote.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The order/quote reference number delta associated with the executed order.

Field.Name: Executed Contracts
Field.Description: The number of contracts executed.

Field.Name: Cross Number
Field.Description: Trade Group Id. Ties together all trades of a given atomic transaction in the matching engine.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Execution Id. Identifies the component of an execution. Unique for a given day. The match number is also referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Message.Name: Single Side Order Executed With Price Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an incoming Side order is executed against the book in whole or in part at a price different from the initial display price. Since the execution price is different than the display price of the original Add/Replace, BX includes a price field within this execution message. It is possible to receive multiple Single Side Executed and Single Side Executed with Price messages for the same Side order if that Side order is executed in several parts. The multiple Single Side Executed messages on the same Side order are cumulative.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The order/quote reference number delta associated with the executed order.

Field.Name: Cross Number
Field.Description: Trade Group Id. Ties together all trades of a given atomic transaction in the matching engine.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Execution Id. Identifies the component of an execution. Unique for a given day. The match number is also referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Indicates if the execution should be reflected on time and sale displays and volume calculations.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The execution contracts.

Message.Name: Order Cancel Message

Message.Name: Single Side Replace Message Short Form
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order or one side of a quote on the book is replaced. The replacement has a new sequence number and replaces the prior sequence number. For bandwidth efficiency reasons, this message can be published in either short or long format.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Original Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The original reference number delta associated with the order being replaced.

Field.Name: New Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The new reference number delta associated with the new order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the replaced order being added to the book. NOTE: When converted to a decimal format, this price is in fixed point format with 3 whole number places followed by 2 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The total number of contracts of the replaced order being added to the book.

Message.Name: Single Side Delete Message
Message.Description: The message is sent when an order or a side of a quote is being cancelled. All remaining contracts are no longer accessible so the side should be removed from the book.

Field.Name: Reference Number Delta

Message.Description: The message is sent when a single quote is being cancelled. All remaining contracts are no longer accessible so the quote should be removed from the book.

Message.Name: Block Delete Message
Message.Description: This message contains a block of Single Side Deletes. Each reference number inside the block represents an order or a side of a quote that is being cancelled. All remaining contracts are no longer accessible so the side should be removed from the book.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Total Number of Reference Number Deltas.
Field.Description: The number of single side deletes in this block. Max possible value = 360

Field.Name: Reference Number Delta(n)
Field.Description: The order/quote side reference number delta associated with the cancelled order/quote. n = 0 to (Total Number – 1)

Value.Name: Start of Messages
Value.Description: Start of Messages. Outside of time stamp messages, the start of day message is the first message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Start of System hours
Value.Description: Start of System hours. This message indicates that NASDAQ is open and ready to start accepting orders.

Value.Name: Start of Market hours
Value.Description: Start of Market hours. This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are available for execution.

Value.Name: End of Market hours
Value.Description: End of Market hours. This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are no longer available for execution.

Value.Name: End of System hours
Value.Description: End of System hours. It indicates that NASDAQ is now closed and will not accept any new orders today. It is still possible to receive Broken Trade messages and Order Delete messages after the End of Day.

Value.Name: End of Messages
Value.Description: End of Messages. This is always the last message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Buy Side Trading Suspended
Value.Description: Buy Side Trading Suspended –i.e. Buy orders are not executable)

Value.Name: Sell Side Trading Suspended
Value.Description: Sell Side Trading Suspended –i.e. Sell orders are not executable)

Value.Name: Broker Dealer/ Non Registered
